About this item

  • Ergonomic Office Chair: Engineered for all-day comfort and rock-solid support, our executive office chair features a reinforced frame and a heavy-duty, 4-level gas lift. Independently tested to withstand 1.5 times the BIFMA standard, it delivers unwavering, shake-free stability with zero gradual sink—so you can tilt, recline, and power through your work with total confidence
  • Smooth 360° Swivel & Adjustable Tilt: Work, relax, or refocus—all without leaving your seat. This ergonomic office chair is built with a 360-degree swivel base and a smooth rocking function. Pull the lock lever for a gentle, secure tilt, or use the adjustable tension knob to customize your rocking resistance exactly how you like it
  • Premium PU Leather: Wrapped in smooth, high-quality PU leather, this desk chair is soft, breathable, and super easy to clean—just wipe it down in seconds. The mid-century modern style instantly elevates the look of your home office, study, or meeting room
  • Ergonomic Lumbar Support: The contoured backrest provides steady lower back support to promote healthy posture and reduce strain, even during long hours of sitting
  • Quick & Easy Adjustments: Use the one-touch pneumatic lever to smoothly adjust the seat height to match your desk or preference in just seconds

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find the office chair to be a perfect home office choice that's comfortable and easy to assemble. The appearance receives positive feedback, with customers noting it looks like a $200 executive chair. However, the support and sturdiness receive mixed reviews - while some find it sturdy with good lumbar support, others report issues with the back not tilting back and material breaking down in spots. Moreover, stability is a concern as the seat sinks down while sitting and doesn't stay in place. Value for money opinions are divided between those who consider it a good buy and those who find it not worth the price.

About this Item

  • Ergonomic Office Chair: Engineered for all-day comfort and rock-solid support, our executive office chair features a reinforced frame and a heavy-duty, 4-level gas lift. Independently tested to withstand 1.5 times the BIFMA standard, it delivers unwavering, shake-free stability with zero gradual sink—so you can tilt, recline, and power through your work with total confidence
  • Smooth 360° Swivel & Adjustable Tilt: Work, relax, or refocus—all without leaving your seat. This ergonomic office chair is built with a 360-degree swivel base and a smooth rocking function. Pull the lock lever for a gentle, secure tilt, or use the adjustable tension knob to customize your rocking resistance exactly how you like it
  • Premium PU Leather: Wrapped in smooth, high-quality PU leather, this desk chair is soft, breathable, and super easy to clean—just wipe it down in seconds. The mid-century modern style instantly elevates the look of your home office, study, or meeting room

Product Description
